title: John Lennon watches Bob Dylan perform in New York City | 1974
content:
John Lennon watched Bob Dylan perform at Madison Square Garden in New York City, USA, on 30 January 1974.

Dylan and The Band were touring, Dylan’s first for eight years. Also in attendance were Yoko Ono, Paul Simon, Jack Nicholson, Allen Ginsberg, and David Geffen.
